Authority shall appoint a Scrutiny Committee, consisting for four members,

No. LEGIS: 1(2)93/7649, dated
25-10-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
7. Amendment of section 7 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.--In the said Ordinance, in section
7,--
(i) for
sub-section (2), the following shall be substituted, namely;
"(2) Any person or an
Organization as mentioned in sub-section (1), interested in establishing a
Degree College, may apply for registration to the Regulatory Authority in such
manner and form as may be prescribed."
(ii) for
sub-section (3), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(3) The Regulatory
Authority shall refer the case to the Scrutiny Committee appointed under
sub-section (3) of section 4 for scrutiny of the case within the meaning of the
said provisions."
(iii) for
sub-section (4), the, following shall be substituted, namely:
"(4) Any person or
Organization, as mentioned in sub-section (1), interested in establishing an
Inter College, may apply to the Board concerned in such form and mariner as may
be prescribed, and the Board shall forward all such applications to the
District Committee concerned constituted under sub-section (4) of section 9 for
scrutiny of the cases in accordance with the provisions of this
Ordinance."; and
(iv) "for
sub-section (5), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(5) Subject to other
provisions of this Ordinance, if the Scrutiny Committee or, as the case may be,
the District Committee, is satisfied that the applicant has submitted a correct
feasibility report and the establishment of the respective college shall help
in the furtherance of the cause of education, it shall,--
(a) in the case
of a Degree College, recommend to the Regulatory Authority;
(b) in the case
of an Inter College, recommend to tire Board concerned, for the establishment
of the respective college and the college may be provisionally
registered."

Educational Institutions Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS: 1(2)93/7649, dated
25-10-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
13. Insertion of a new section
to N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.--In the said Ordinance, alter
section 13, as so amended, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:--
"13A. Settlement
of disputes.--(1) The Regulatory Authority or, as the case may be, the
Board, shall -have exclusive authority in respect of registration of private
educational institutions within their respective jurisdiction and in respect of
matters relating to deputes arising between the Government and the registered institutions,
the Regulatory Authority or the Board and the registered institutions, the
University and the registered institutions, or any dispute pertaining to the
staff of the institutions, or complaints of parents about fees, conditions of
buildings of the institutions, staff employed and other related matters.
(2) The Regulatory Authority or,
as the case may be, the Board, shall be responsible for supervision and
performance of evaluation of the registered institutions within their
respective jurisdiction in the manner determined by them within their
respective authority."
